title: Create a file by typing content directly into the terminal
summary: Start a command that lets you type text directly into the terminal and save it to a file. Press Ctrl+D to finish and save the file.

steps.explain: Use `cat -` to read from standard input (your keyboard) and redirect it to a file. Type your content, then press Ctrl+D to end input and save the file.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The name of the file to create

steps.expect: The terminal waits for input. After typing text and pressing Ctrl+D, the file is created with that content.
